description: Flappy Kiro — tunable game parameters. All physics values assume a 600px-tall reference canvas. At runtime, scale time-based values by (canvas.height / 600) for gravity/velocity and (canvas.width / 800) for horizontal speeds.

physics._comment: Time-based values. Multiply by (canvas.height / 600) at runtime.
physics._scalingNote: gravity and jumpVelocity scale with canvas.height / referenceHeight

walls._comment: Horizontal values. Multiply by (canvas.width / 800) at runtime.
walls._scalingNote: speed and spacing scale with canvas.width / referenceWidth

gap._comment: Vertical value. Multiply by (canvas.height / 600) at runtime.
gap._scalingNote: size and margins scale with canvas.height / referenceHeight

kiro._startXNote: Horizontal position as a fraction of canvas.width
kiro._renderScaleNote: Multiply sprite dimensions by renderScale for display size

reference._note: All absolute pixel values above are calibrated to this reference resolution. Scale proportionally at runtime.
